_about: Constants this primer cites, copied verbatim (values and source strings) from ../jetson-orin-thor-metrics/constants.json. Do not retype into prose; load this file. The authoritative copy is the metrics kit; this is a cited subset. 'board' is orin, thor, or both. Rates are at MAXN with GPU clocks locked unless the source string says otherwise.
